items.title: Create a centralized flow fact policy registry for process facts
items.context: Process facts that affect phase, review, test, DONE, finding/pass, evidence, branch/worktree, or cleanup must be represented in code as policy metadata rather than only prompt/docs text.
items.userSees: Terminal output includes: "flow fact policy: review-pass -> artifact review-passes.json -> gate storyMachine.canPassReview" and "flow fact policy: express-verification-policy -> express-exempt".

happy.desc: Registry exposes explicit flow fact policy entries for review pass, finding, review round, and express verification exemption.

edge.desc: Registry contract test fails if an L4 gate fact lacks consumer gate, artifact, or required semantics.

adversarial.desc: No new parallel policy table is introduced that can drift from process-fact-registry.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm run test:flow-stability-smoke && npm run test:process-fact-contract
verificationEvidence.note: Current HEAD build plus flow-stability and process-fact-contract prove registry exposes flow-policy review-pass, finding, pass-only-normalization, review-round-iso-string, and express-verification-policy entries.
Process fact contract verifies L4 gate facts, artifacts, consumer gates, and required semantics; it would fail on missing gate/artifact/semantic drift.
Smoke asserts PROCESS_FACT_FLOW_POLICIES is built from the single FLOW_FACT_POLICIES table to prevent drift.

items.title: Enforce review fact schema and pass-only normalization in handlers
items.context: reviewRound doc/runtime drift and pass-only finding records should be mechanically normalized or rejected at the handler/schema boundary, not left to reviewer prompt behavior.
items.userSees: Terminal output includes: "Review pass B-xxxx:RP-001 recorded by koala-review-docs"; `finding_list` returns "findings: []" for pass-only records; docs say "reviewRound: string (ISO 8601 review round id)".

happy.desc: Pass-only finding_add records review pass evidence and does not persist an open finding.
reviewRound schema is consistently treated as an ISO string in runtime types, docs, and smoke assertions.

edge.desc: Ambiguous text containing pass plus failure language remains a real finding instead of being normalized to pass.

adversarial.desc: Non-reviewer or non-low severity pass-like finding_add is not accepted as review pass evidence.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm run test:field-regression-cli-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Fresh run after handler fix: pass-only finding_add records Review pass B-passonly:RP-* and finding_list stays empty for pass-only records.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm run test:flow-stability-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Fresh run after handler fix: flow smoke verifies reviewRound flow policy remains registered as schema-contract with ISO string semantics.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm run test:field-regression-cli-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Fresh run after handler fix: ambiguous pass plus failure text creates a real open finding instead of review pass evidence.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm run test:field-regression-cli-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Fresh run after handler fix: non-low/non-reviewer pass-like calls remain findings, and direct handler pass-only text with unknown category throws before review-pass normalization.

items.title: Make express verification policy explicit and machine-readable
items.context: Express stories intentionally bypass PLAN verificationIntent. That exemption should be a structured policy visible to validation/review outputs, not an implicit reviewer explanation.
items.userSees: Validation output includes: "Verification policy: express-exempt (channel=express; PLAN verificationIntent intentionally skipped)". Non-express output keeps "Verification intent coverage: no explicit verificationIntent entries".

happy.desc: Express channel stories with zero verificationIntent render a structured express-exempt verification policy message.

edge.desc: Normal or fast channel stories with zero verificationIntent do not receive the express-exempt message.

adversarial.desc: A risky story with two checklist items is forced normal and cannot hide missing intent behind express exemption.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:outcome-semantics-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Outcome semantics smoke verifies express channel zero verificationIntent renders the structured express-exempt verification policy message.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:outcome-semantics-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Outcome semantics smoke verifies fast and normal zero-intent stories do not render express-exempt and keep ordinary missing-intent output.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:outcome-semantics-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Outcome semantics smoke verifies risky two-item stories are forced normal and cannot hide missing intent behind express exemption.

items.title: Add regression tests for flow fact policy enforcement
items.context: Historical drift signals should be locked by smoke tests covering registry availability, reviewRound normalization, pass-only finding behavior, and express verification policy.
items.userSees: Smoke output ends with: "flow fact policy smoke passed" and field regression output still includes: "field regression CLI smoke passed".

happy.desc: A dedicated smoke command passes and covers registry completeness, pass-only normalization, ISO reviewRound, and express-exempt output.

edge.desc: Existing field regression smoke and process fact contract script continue to pass with strengthened assertions.

adversarial.desc: Tests fail if express exemption is shown for non-express stories or if pass-only records appear as findings.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm run test:flow-stability-smoke && npm run test:field-regression-cli-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:outcome-semantics-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Fresh build plus smoke coverage passes for registry completeness, pass-only normalization, ISO reviewRound policy, unknown-category pass-only rejection, and express-exempt rendering.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm run test:field-regression-cli-smoke && npm run test:process-fact-contract
verificationEvidence.note: Fresh build plus existing field regression smoke and strengthened process fact contract both pass, including direct handler unknown category pass-only guard.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm run test:field-regression-cli-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:outcome-semantics-smoke && git diff --check
verificationEvidence.note: Fresh build plus adversarial tests fail if pass-only records appear in finding_list, if unknown pass-only category normalizes to review pass, or if non-express zero-intent stories render express-exempt; git diff --check passed.

auditLog.reason: Implemented centralized flow fact policy registry and contract coverage
Centralized pass-only normalization and reviewRound ISO evidence
Rendered express verification policy and guarded non-express zero-intent output
Added regression coverage for flow fact policies and required commands
